About us

Our story.

Impact Water was born from a simple realization: something as essential as drinking water should not come at the cost of our health or the planet.

How it began

Rethinking the way water is packaged and consumed.

With growing awareness around the harmful effects of plastic pollution and microplastics on both the environment and the human body, we saw an opportunity to rethink the way water is packaged and consumed. The result was Impact Water, a brand designed to provide a smarter, more responsible alternative to traditional plastic bottles.

Paper-based packaging

The name

Small everyday choices, meaningful change.

The name “Impact” represents our belief that even small everyday choices can create meaningful change. By choosing better packaging and more conscious consumption habits, we can reduce plastic waste and move toward a healthier future for both people and the planet.

Our purpose

Impact Water exists to challenge the way the world consumes water.

Eliminate single-use plastic waste

By offering a smarter alternative: high-quality drinking water in responsibly designed, paper-based packaging.

Make responsible choices easier

Through every carton, we aim to raise awareness around plastic pollution and inspire individuals and businesses to rethink everyday habits that impact the environment.

Reimagining the bottle

Making sustainable choices a natural part of everyday life.

Sustainability

Small sips, big change.

If we take from the planet, we should give back. Every carton is built on that idea.

Our commitment

1% of revenue, back to the planet.

We're proud to partner with 1% for the Planet, the global movement of purpose-driven brands that includes Patagonia and 818 Tequila.

Through this partnership, Impact Water commits to donating at least 1% of our annual revenue to environmental organizations working to address some of the world’s most pressing environmental challenges. These initiatives support efforts from reducing plastic pollution and protecting oceans to restoring ecosystems and supporting climate solutions.

Water is one of the planet’s most essential natural resources, and as a water brand, we believe we have a responsibility to help protect the ecosystems that sustain it. By partnering with 1% for the Planet, we aim to ensure that every carton of Impact Water contributes not only to better packaging, but also to meaningful environmental action.

Partner of 1% for the Planet

Thoughtful packaging

Sustainability goes beyond replacing plastic bottles.

At Impact Water, we believe every part of the packaging process should be as responsible as possible.

FSC® certified cartons

Our cartons are made from FSC® certified paperboard, meaning the raw materials come from responsibly managed forests that protect biodiversity, prevent deforestation, and support sustainable forestry practices.

The Forest Stewardship Council (FSC®) is a globally recognized certification that ensures forests are managed in an environmentally responsible, socially beneficial, and economically viable way. This helps ensure that the materials used in our packaging come from sources that respect both nature and the communities that depend on it.

Paper tape

Even the smallest details matter. That’s why our shipping boxes are sealed using paper tape instead of traditional plastic tape, making the packaging easier to recycle and reducing unnecessary plastic.

Seed paper inserts

We include seed paper with our boxes, which can be planted to grow plants and trees. Instead of becoming waste, these inserts are designed to give something back to the environment.

These small choices may seem simple, but together they reflect our broader commitment to creating a product that is more thoughtful and responsible for the planet.

Recycling our cartons

Because sustainability doesn’t end when the product is consumed.

  1. 1

    Closing the loop

    While cartons use significantly less plastic than traditional bottles, responsible packaging also means ensuring materials are properly recovered and recycled. Impact Water works with recycling partners and facilities that are capable of processing beverage cartons. These facilities separate the different materials within the cartons, allowing them to be recovered and reused in the production of new materials. Through these partnerships, we aim to ensure that cartons collected within our capacity are diverted from landfills and reintroduced into the recycling system.

  2. 2

    Giving cartons a second life

    Through our recycling partners, used cartons can be recovered and transformed into new composite materials used to create a variety of durable products, including coasters, tables, chairs, and other everyday items. By separating and repurposing the materials within the cartons, these resources are given a second life, supporting a more circular approach to materials. By extending the lifecycle of our packaging, we aim to reduce waste and demonstrate how thoughtful design can continue to create value even after a product has served its original purpose.
